source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Everything in this design looks good, but I’d like it to feel more cartoon-ish... Please use this kind of cartoon style... The words "Storytelling is learned at the Carne Asada" on the meat were supposed to appear stamped onto it, like they do on the burger. Does that make sense?
